display.purpose: Page titles and selected Alert headings establish an editorial reading order.

body.purpose: Keep controls, source status, and dense Alert details direct and familiar.

shadows.name: account-surface
shadows.purpose: Very low separation for account and Place-management surfaces.

shadows.name: selected-alert-record
shadows.purpose: Lift the selected Alert detail from the folio without adding a colored glow.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Quiet hover feedback on buttons and selectable rows.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Honor the operating system preference for reduced motion.

narrative.overview: AlertMesh reads like a dependable field reference. People move from Places to the Inbox and into a selected Alert record. Cool green-gray paper, evergreen ink, and ruled divisions keep information calm and practical across the demo and account surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Place-first orientation with a distinct Alert ledger and detail record.
Cool paper tones, evergreen ink, and limited hazard colors.
Serif display headings with clear sans-serif interface text.
Fine rules and restrained elevation separate records.

rules.name: The Status-in-Words Rule
rules.body: Pair colored source and hazard cues with labels or shape so status remains clear without color perception.

rules.name: The Legible Record Rule
rules.body: Keep functional labels and metadata at or above the documented label size; use spacing and weight for hierarchy.

dos: Keep Places, the Inbox, and the selected Alert record easy to scan in that order.
Keep source freshness and Alert guidance visible in the detail view.
Use hazard color sparingly and retain textual state labels.
donts: Do not present stale source data as current.
Do not rely on small text, color alone, decorative grids, or glow effects to carry meaning.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Use for the main action in a form or account flow.
components.css: .action-button.primary { min-height: 39px; padding: 8px 13px; border: 1px solid #285447; border-radius: 5px; color: #f8faf7; background: #285447; font: 650 11px/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color .16s ease, border-color .16s ease; } .action-button.primary:hover { border-color: #183b32; background: #183b32; } .action-button.primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a96915; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Alert ledger row
components.description: A selectable Inbox entry that keeps type, state, title, matching Places, and time together.
components.css: .alert-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 4px minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 13px; padding: 15px 10px 14px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #d1d6ca; color: #24342e; background: transparent; text-align: left; } .alert-card[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #e4e9df; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #d7dfd3; } .alert-title { color: #183b32; font: 500 18px/1.25 Georgia, serif; }
